mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS levels show no significant positive correlation with 20-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM does not yield positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During monetary tightening cycles, INDPRO declines are not associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 returns (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 or t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST levels show no significant positive correlation with 5-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising HOUST and strong RSAFS does not yield positive 5-day returns in > 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a low unemployment rate signals strong economic conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In labor market tightness regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), low unemployment rates do not produce positive 60-day S&P 500 returns (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 or t-test p > 0.05).
